environment.description: Same Lambda and Step Functions workflow deployed with document encryption keys held in AWS CloudHSM cluster (cloudhsm-cluster-abc123) via KMS custom key store. The CMK (alias/doc-encrypt-hsm) is backed by the CloudHSM cluster with key material that never leaves the HSM boundary. The KMS key policy includes a StringEquals condition on kms:EncryptionContext:owner_id matching ${aws:PrincipalTag/user_id} from the caller's session. The Lambda execution role assumes a scoped session via STS with a transitive tag 'user_id' propagated from the Cognito identity token through API Gateway request context mapping template ($context.authorizer.claims.sub). CloudHSM audit logging enabled to CloudWatch with tamper-evident log group.

config.lambda_role_session: STS AssumeRole with TransitiveTagKeys: [user_id], sourced from Cognito sub claim
config.encryption_context_at_rest: Each document encrypted with EncryptionContext including owner_id field
config.hsm_audit: CloudWatch log group /aws/cloudhsm/audit with retention lock
